assumptions: Feeds: mm/min = rpm x flutes x chip load (in/tooth) x 25.4; drills rpm x 0.1 mm/rev, peck = 1 x D.
T2 chip load 0.005 in/tooth (middle of 0.004-0.006) for adaptive and profile, 0.002 for the helical port trepan; plunge/ramp feed = half the horizontal feed for end mills.
T1 at 3000 rpm (spindle-limited choice), 70 % step-over zig-zag over the whole stock.
Frame stock = 317.5 x 228.6 x 127 blank with the 274 x 184 core already waterjet/bandsawn out: the outside is cut by Adaptive (stock box), the opening by Profile only (3 mm radial).
Setup A cuts outside and opening to z 58, setup B from the bottom to z 58 (meet line at mid-height).
Floor setup B stock = 312 x 222 outline box (outside already cut in A, down to z -20.5) so the Adaptive only cuts the U-notches (and four corner slivers); the 2.2 mm web under z -20.5 is faced off.
Face ops: BoundaryShape Boundbox with ClearEdges (the face's bounding box plus the tool radius) and ZigZagAngle 0, so the turns run along the x edges and the outer passes along the y edges.
Floor port trepan and slots: final depth z -23.2, 0.5 mm past the blank, so the slugs drop in A.
Slots 124 x 8 and 20 x 104 both on a 1/4 in. end mill (T9): T3 1/2 in. does not fit an 8 mm slot.

Drills: largest of 3.3/4.2/5.0/6.0 mm that fits each hole step; taps, reamers, insert tools, chamfers and deburring are not costed. Tool changes are counted, not timed. Floor holes: those that open on top (and not on the bottom) are drilled in setup A, the rest from below in B; the step nearest the entry face first. Steps whose far end opens at full diameter (through) get ExtraOffset = Drill Tip; blind steps stop with the drill tip at the model's flat floor, so their full diameter ends 0.3 x D short.

Setup C (F-S3, since 2026-11-25): the four walls on an HRT210, one FreeCAD job per A index in the machine frame at that index (A along machine X, work zero on the A axis), joined into one Haas program with the A moves (gcode/frame_C_haas.nc). A0 front: the door opening, T3 adaptive through the 16 mm wall. A90 left and A270 right: the 18 mm recoater bores and the 25.4 mm KF-25 bore helix-milled with T3; the through-beam's 10.8 mm counterbore and the SAE-4 O2 port (to its 9.92 mm tap drill) with T9; the holes drilled with their tap or STI drill (TAP_DRILL). A180 back: the 120 x 8 inlet slot profiled with T9, the argon SAE-4 port, the plenum inserts, pins and rail holes. Taps, STI taps, reamers and the SAE port tool are not programmed.
freecad_notes: Primary times are the G-code recount (cut_time_min, rapid_time_min). FreeCAD's own estimate (freecad_cycle_time per op, Job CycleTime) is whole seconds and, tested on single moves in 1.0.2, times any move that changes Z at the vertical (plunge) feed over its full 3D length, ignores the F words, and does not expand G81/G83 cycles; so it reads high for ramps, helices and pocket entries.
Drilling.Create()/Helix.Create() raise TypeError headless in 1.0.2 (findAllHoles runs before the op has a model); the ops are built from ObjectDrilling/ObjectHelix directly.
Helix generator in 1.0.2 puts a single helix at (outer+inner)/2; worked around (see the script) so the port trepan runs on radius 48 - D/2.
